description.value: The Coffee Pitt is an independent community cafe in Pitt Meadows specializing in specialty espresso drinks, freshly baked goods, and made-to-order sandwiches using locally roasted beans. Beyond the daytime cafe menu, the shop offers a cocktail program featuring espresso martinis and aperol spritzes, and rents its venue for private events after closing. Cyclists riding the Pitt Meadows area trails and dyke routes will find vegan and gluten-free options alongside the signature cinnamon buns.

address.value: 12528 Harris Road, Pitt Meadows, BC V3Y 2H1

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides detailed information about The Coffee Pitt. The menu page explicitly lists vegan and gluten-free items ('Vegan Breakfast Sandwich', 'Gluten Free Brownie', 'Gluten Free Cookie'), and the site has an active shopping cart/SHOP section plus catering ordering, confirming takeout availability. The website consistently shows postal code V3Y 2H1 across all subpages, while OSM tags show V3Y 2J4 — a discrepancy flagged in concerns. No bike parking, washroom, Wi-Fi, or water refill information appears anywhere on the website.
concerns: Postal code mismatch: OSM has V3Y 2J4 but website consistently shows V3Y 2H1 across all subpages — website value used; OSM should be corrected.
OSM opening_hours (Mo-Fr 07:00-17:00; Sa-Su 08:00-17:00) differs from website which states '8:00am to 5:00pm Daily' — website indicates uniform daily hours.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating independent cafe with a full website, confirmed phone number, and detailed menu — a clear and useful stop for touring cyclists in Pitt Meadows.
enrichment_extras.notes: Phone number 604-457-2400 and email info@thecoffeepitt.com sourced from website; not present in OSM tags.
